name: Sadashiv Shetty
current_role: Chairman & Executive Director, Heranba Industries Ltd (Vapi, Gujarat)
profile: Sadashiv K. Shetty co-founded Heranba Industries in 1992 with Raghuram K. Shetty; it grew into a crop-protection chemicals maker and exporter (insecticides, herbicides, fungicides) based in Vapi, listed in India in 2021. He chairs the company and holds about 18% of it.
interesting_fact: Heranba's own site describes it as founded in 1992 by 'technocrats' Sadashiv K. Shetty and Raghuram K. Shetty; Sadashiv studied at the University of Mysore.
deep_cut_fact: In April 2024 he also became non-executive chairman of Daikaffil Chemicals India, a separate listed specialty-chemicals company.
notes: Wealth is shared with co-promoter Raghuram K. Shetty (Managing Director). Low media profile; corporate office in Mumbai (Borivali). Deep-cut source is an aggregator; verify with a Daikaffil BSE filing.

name: Seema Suryavanshi
current_role: Promoter/shareholder of Dilip Buildcon Ltd (Bhopal); former executive director (2006-2010)
profile: Seema Suryavanshi is a promoter of Dilip Buildcon, the Bhopal road and infrastructure EPC contractor founded by her husband Dilip Suryavanshi, who is chairman. She was a director of the company from 2006 to 2010 and has sat on boards of group entities such as Suryavanshi Infrastructure and DBL toll-road SPVs.
interesting_fact: Dilip Buildcon grew from a small Bhopal contractor into one of India's largest road builders; she was on its board when it incorporated as a company in 2006.
notes: Low public profile. Best route is through the company (head of IR Gautam Jain is named on earnings calls) or via Dilip/Rohan Suryavanshi. Her current board status is unclear: sources conflict.
